evals.prompt: I need some post ideas for this week. I just got back from the AREUEA conference and I'm also about to launch a new AI consulting engagement with a regional multifamily operator.
evals.expected_output: 5-7 post ideas spanning academic and business content pillars, with platform recommendations for each
expectations: Provides at least 5 distinct post ideas
Includes ideas for both academic (conference) and business (AI consulting) content
Recommends specific platforms for each idea
Ideas are specific and actionable, not generic
Does not reveal hypothetical client details

evals.prompt: Help me write a LinkedIn post about my new working paper on political connections and firm value. The key finding is that connections to local politicians matter more than federal ones for real estate firms.
evals.expected_output: A complete, ready-to-post LinkedIn post with a strong hook, body, CTA, and hashtags
expectations: First two lines contain a compelling hook
Includes the specific finding about local vs federal connections
Ends with a question or call to action
Tone is conversational but credible, not overly academic

evals.prompt: Plan my social media for next week. I want to share some thoughts on how AI agents are changing CRE underwriting. Give me a full calendar with drafts.
evals.expected_output: A 2-3 post content calendar with specific days, platforms, and complete draft content for each post
expectations: Provides 2-3 posts spread across the week
Each post has a specific day and suggested time
Each post has complete draft text ready to post
Posts are adapted for their respective platforms
Content specifically addresses AI agents in CRE underwriting
